description: This file defines a mock class DataReaderMock for unit testing, which inherits from IDataReader and uses Google Mock to mock the readData method. It is part of the firebolt::rialto::server namespace and is used for testing media data reading functionality.

classes.name: DataReaderMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of IDataReader for testing purposes, providing a mocked readData method.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Mocked method that simulates reading media data, returning a vector of media segments.
